name: listing.my
title: Field: listing.my
description: Meaning of the buyer-visible listing.my field.
text:
# listing.my

TL;DR:
- True means the published listing belongs to the current authenticated user.

What it means:
- listing.my is an actor-specific ownership flag in buyer context.
- It does not mean the listing is private or editable through buyer tools.

Agent hint:
- Use this when the workflow needs to distinguish the user's own listings from other people's listings.
